note: gold holds entry names; the qualified name is qn_prefix + name. lookup gold is hand-labelled; graph and facet gold is computed from the catalog (repos linking to `seed`, repos matching `args`). All answers refer to this frozen corpus, not current GitHub state. Multi-repository gold requires all listed repositories; order matters only when args specifies order. negative has empty gold: a correct answer says the corpus provides no matching evidence. Per-question notes explain the labels and are for evaluation only, never part of the agent's question.
